blocker.message: Archived Savills LotList WARC captures successfully map legacy auction IDs to exact 2019 auction dates, but the existing recovery produced no usable lot URLs because pid-bearing LotDetails links are embedded in the archived catalogue HTML rather than guaranteed to appear as Common Crawl index-row URLs.

repair_implemented_same_run.route: Parse archived Savills LotList WARC capture bodies for exact LotDetails?aid=...&pid=... links, then validate each candidate against a surviving first-party Savills page before canonical History V2 persistence.
repair_implemented_same_run.fallback_if_zero: Query exact legacy LotDetails URL prefixes by recovered aid across deterministic 2019 Common Crawl indexes, then validate surviving first-party Savills pages before persistence.
